GraphNode.description: One ticket, as the graph holds it.

blocked_by.description: Node ids this ticket's `Blocked by:` line names. A name matching no ticket stays here unresolved and keeps the node blocked.
blocked_by.title: Blocked By

graph.description: The graph this node's session spawned — the effort directory name — or None while it has spawned none.
graph.title: Graph

missing_artifacts.description: Owed artifacts the target repo cannot back up, as of the last stale point. What the nudge count is counting.
missing_artifacts.title: Missing Artifacts

node_id.description: The ticket file's stem — what `Blocked by:` lines name.
node_id.title: Node Id

nudge_count.description: Consecutive nudge points — stale points at which a completion was refused — with no shrink in the owed set. Any shrinking starts it again.
nudge_count.title: Nudge Count

session_id.description: Join key to the session record.
session_id.title: Session Id

task_mode.description: How a `task` ticket resolves, classified at emit time. None for every other type, and for a task nothing has classified yet.

ticket.description: The ticket file's path, relative to the target repo.
ticket.title: Ticket

ticket_type.description: From the ticket's `Type:` line; `implement` when it has none.

GraphNode.title: GraphNode

NodeStatus.description:
A node's status is its session's status.

A node reaching `DONE` says nothing about a subgraph it may have spawned.
NodeStatus.title: NodeStatus

TaskResolutionMode.description:
Which of three ways a `task` ticket gets resolved.

Decided by the orchestrator agent when it emits the graph, never by the
loop and never at dispatch time.
TaskResolutionMode.title: TaskResolutionMode

TicketType.description:
What a ticket's `Type:` line says it is.

The wayfinder vocabulary plus `implement` for the tickets that have no
`Type:` line at all — a spec's implementation tickets, which are typed by
their absence of a type.
TicketType.title: TicketType

description:
`.scratch/<effort>/graph.json` — beside the tickets it came from.

The graph id *is* the effort directory name, so nothing has to invent an
identifier. Node order is ticket-file order, which the tracker's own
"first by number wins" convention makes the dispatch order among peers.

spawned_by.description: The run-wide id of the node whose session wrote these tickets.
spawned_by.title: Spawned By

title: Graph
